data.name: MemoriaDestination
data.value: Magic rules, personal Attack choices or usage history require a Memoria save. Choose a Memoria slot; original FF8 files remain intact.

data.name: AttackSlotHelp
data.value: The first slot remains Attack. Smart Attack unlocks a personal physical or magic preference.

data.name: AttackChoiceHelp
data.value: Choose physical attacks or automatic magic using the normal Magic command and casting rules.

data.name: SharedDescription
data.value: Use one party magic bank with exclusive Junction owners. Review quantities, overflow, bindings and HP before changing this save.

data.name: InfiniteDescription
data.value: Preserve casting stock and spend limited battle or field uses. Junction bonuses still use stock; victory restores one field use.

data.name: SmartDescription
data.value: Unlock personal automatic Attack choices. Uses hidden enemy information and favorable spell selection; ordinary costs and command restrictions apply.

data.name: ReviewHelp
data.value: Review every change. Apply commits the entire migration; Cancel leaves the save unchanged.

data.name: NoStockChanges
data.value: No stock, Junction or maximum HP changes.

data.name: SmartLocked
data.value: Enable Smart Attack in Config to change this preference.

data.name: ConservativeHelp
data.value: Conservative Auto Junction preserves every other character's spell ownership.

data.name: PartyHelp
data.value: Review ownership and HP changes before allowing Auto Junction to reassign other characters' spells.

data.name: CommandSlotHelp
data.value: Select a command for this slot.

data.name: SettingBeginHelp
data.value: Start a new game with these gameplay rules. More settings are available in Config.

data.name: DeferredReview
data.value: A magic mode change is pending. Review the migration before applying it.

data.name: StockHelp
data.value: Browse stock, remaining field uses and Junction ownership.
